name: Zhejiang China Light&Textile Industrial City Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang China Light&Textile Industrial City Group Co.,Ltd, with its headquarters located in Shaoxing, China, focuses primarily on the development, leasing, and ongoing management of commercial properties within the prominent China Textile City market. Established in 1993, the company's expansive operations also include the wholesale distribution of textile fabrics, various market coordination services, financial provisions, and the oversight of e-commerce platforms. Additionally, the Group is responsible for the establishment, operation, and administration of an international logistics hub.
